panels.title: Handler Panics Recovered
panels.description: A handler panicked and the recovery middleware returned 500. Any non-zero value is an alert; pivot via the matching http.PanicRecovered audit entry.

panels.title: Encryption Flag Mismatches
panels.description: An object's stored bytes disagree with its recorded encryption flag, so that copy cannot be read or hashed. Any non-zero value is an alert.

panels.title: Verification Coverage (oldest unverified)
panels.description: How long ago the least recently verified copy was checked. Should sit flat around the period implied by scrubber_interval and scrubber_batch_size; a steadily climbing line means the sweep cannot keep pace with the fleet.

panels.title: Copies Never Verified
panels.description: Copies with a content hash the scrubber has not reached yet. Stays non-zero on a fleet being written to, since new copies queue behind older data by design. Alert on a climbing value, not on it being above zero.

panels.title: Unreadable Imports
panels.description: Reconcile or sync found an encrypted object whose key is gone. Unrecoverable: restore from elsewhere or delete it. Any non-zero rate wants a human.

panels.title: Pending Intents Depth
panels.description: Unresolved PUT intents waiting for the reaper. Steady-state should be 0; persistent non-zero indicates the reaper is not draining (DB outage, backend HEAD failures, or operator-review-required ambiguous rows).

panels.title: Pending Intent Throughput
panels.description: Rate of intents enqueued by the write path versus resolved by status. Steady state has enqueued and committed close to equal; promoted/dropped events indicate the reaper is repairing failed commits.

panels.title: Ambiguous Intents (lifetime)
panels.description: Lifetime count of pending intents the reaper refused to promote because the destination already held a row for the same key. These rows stay in the database for operator review; any non-zero value warrants investigation.

panels.title: Streaming Payload Requests
panels.description: Rate of streaming-SigV4 PUTs received, by AWS streaming variant.

panels.title: Streaming Payload Rejections
panels.description: Rate of streaming-SigV4 PUTs rejected mid-stream, by reason. Any non-zero rate is either a misconfigured client or a tampered request.

panels.title: Worker tick rate by service & result
Rows graduated to DLQ by backend
Degraded mode active
panels.description: 1 when the DB circuit breaker is open or half-open; reads broadcast across backends.

panels.title: Degraded broadcast duration
panels.description: Wall-clock p50/p95/p99 of degraded-mode broadcast reads, by terminal outcome.

panels.title: Degraded broadcast mixed outcomes
panels.description: Rate of broadcasts where backends disagreed: some returned 404 while others failed with non-404 errors. Persistent non-zero values suggest provider divergence or a transient backend storm hidden under not_found.

panels.title: Broadcast Drain Timeouts
panels.description: Loser-drain goroutines that gave up at the bounded timeout because a cancelled probe never returned. Non-zero means a backend is stranding goroutines under degraded fan-out.
